subject: MeadowBank POC — success gates, streaming hooks & implementation owners
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen@meadowbank.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: MeadowBank POC — success gates, streaming hooks & implementation owners

Hi Ellen — great conversation earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before we kick off the POC (we’re calling this the "proofflow"):

What we heard from you:
- Primary use case: customer interaction summarization + routing for fraud ops (low latency, <250ms token turn).
- Typical request size: ~600 tokens average, spikes to 3k for long sessions.
- Data: anonymized transaction metadata + customer chat text (no PII in feed).
- Must support streaming responses into your CRM webhook and function/tool calls for ticket creation.

Proposed 3-week proofflow scope (high level):
1) Week 0 (prep): VPC peering + KMS key exchange, sample payloads exchanged.
2) Week 1: SDK wiring and prototype: Chat streaming (route /v1/chat/stream) + function calling to create tickets in Zendesk.
3) Week 2: Load experiment and cost/latency profiling (50 rps sustained), prefix caching enabled for repeated queries.
4) Week 3: Acceptance run against success gates and handoff to CS for production plan.

Success gates (must pass all):
- Average 95th latency <350ms for 600-token requests at 50 rps.
- Summaries meet F1 >= 0.78 against your reviewer set (we’ll use your ~120 test cases).
- Function calls create tickets in Zendesk with correct metadata mapping in >= 98% of cases.

Owners (initial):
- Redwood demo & SDK lead: Ben Carter (ben_carter@redwood.ai) — owns prototype and streaming wiring.
- Redwood CSM: Vivek Kulkarni — post-acceptance ramp + training.
- MeadowBank infra contact: Laura (please confirm the infra owner if it’s someone else).

Technical notes / recommended wiring:
- Use our JavaScript SDK with streaming flag (example route: POST /v1/chat/stream?stream=true).
- Enable function calling for ticket creation — provide function schema in sample_api_schema.json (attached).
- Prefix/KV caching: enable for repeat queries; we’ll recommend cache TTL = 20m for this workload.
- Quantization hint: start with int8 profile for cost testing; we can switch to float16 if higher fidelity is required.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (MVP tasks & owners), sample_api_schema.json (function schemas).

Ask / next steps:
1) Ellen — confirm the infra contact for VPC peering and a preferred initial start date (we suggested Sep 27).
2) MeadowBank to share an anonymized sample of ~120 transcripts and expected fields by EOD Friday.
3) Ben/Laura/Vivek — can you confirm availability for the kickoff and who will own the Zendesk webhook?

Thanks — I’ll queue a short kickoff invite once I have the infra owner and sample data.

— Priya
Priya Natarajan

Thanks Priya — this looks good and matches what we discussed. A couple clarifications: 
- We can provide an anonymized subset of 150 transcripts (good) and a schema for the transaction metadata. Expect that by Friday EOD.
- For streaming: we need to stream partial summaries into our internal CRM (via webhook). Is redwood able to stream incremental tokens with function-calling enabled?
- Security: MeadowBank will require the standard security questionnaire and evidence for SOC2 scope — I’ll loop in our InfoSec if you can share the questionnaire link.

Tentative start date Sep 27 works for us. Laura is actually our infra lead (laura.bennett@meadowbank.io) — I’ll CC her on separate note.

— Ellen
Ellen Park
Head of Platform Engineering | MeadowBank
ellen@meadowbank.io
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-18T18:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MeadowBank POC — success gates, streaming hooks & implementation owners

Looping in a few tech details so we can move fast:
- Streaming + function calling: yes. Implementation pattern: SDK opens a server-sent events stream against /v1/chat/stream. Tokens come as SSE events; function invocation event is emitted when the model returns a function call payload. We’ll include a small middleware lib to translate function calls to a signed webhook POST to MeadowBank’s CRM.
- Backpressure/throughput: use our client-side batching with maxBatchSize=8 and timeout=40ms for this profile.
- Observability: we’ll include a tracing header (x-redwood-trace) so you can correlate requests in your APM.

Action items for us: Ben -> prototype stream + function adapter and share a small demo repo by Sep 24. Laura (MeadowBank) -> share webhook URL and test creds. Vivek -> prepare acceptance checklist and coordinate training sessions post-acceptance.
